thesis: Documentary understanding must preserve use-relevant conditions, exceptions, temporality, modality and attribution.
role: Apply distinction learning while separating extraction and inference.

ideas.statement: Documentary understanding must preserve use-relevant conditions, exceptions, temporality, modality and attribution.
ideas.recurrenceCandidate: Apply distinction learning while separating extraction and inference.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A threshold-only summary misses a critical-resource exception, and a hypothesis may be unjustifiably promoted to fact.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Correct inference over wrong extraction remains unfaithful; synthetic success and stylistic preference do not establish real-world usefulness.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
